A1.justification: Both PDFs contain the same GraphKeeper research work, with complete main text and Appendices A–G. Text extraction and rendered-page comparison support a reliable comparison without material gaps.

before.justification: v1 reports original graph domain-incremental learning experiments, including benchmark comparisons, GFM integration, ablations, and additional evaluations in Appendix E.

after.justification: v2 retains the same original experimental results in Section 5 and the appendices, including accuracy, forgetting, ablation, and visualization results.

M1.justification: Sections 4.1–4.3 and Algorithms 1–2 are unchanged, including domain-specific LoRA, disentanglement objectives, recursive ridge regression, and domain discrimination.

E1.justification: Both versions evaluate the same 15 datasets and domain groups, including the same few-shot setting and longer incremental sequences documented in Appendices C and E.

E2.justification: Comparator membership is unchanged in Tables 1, 2, E.3, and E.4 and the embedding comparisons. This includes the same GIL baselines and GCOPE/MDGPT integration comparisons.

E3.justification: The incremental orders, 60/20/20 data splits, feature alignment, few-shot sampling, training settings, and AA/AF evaluation metrics are identical in Section 5.1 and Appendices C–D.

E4.justification: Both retain identical component ablations, hyperparameter sweeps, unified-GCN comparisons, domain-confusion analysis, and embedding visualizations in Section 5 and the appendices.

E5.justification: Both specify five independent runs and report the same means and standard deviations. No run-count, uncertainty-reporting, or statistical-testing changes appear.

E6.justification: Numerical entries, rankings, plotted results, and qualitative findings are identical in Tables 1–2, Tables E.3–E.4, and all experimental figures. No results are added or removed.

T1.justification: The mathematical formulation and equations are unchanged, including the recursive ridge-regression derivation in Appendix A and complexity analysis in Appendix B.2.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, and conclusion retain identical novelty and contribution claims, including negligible forgetting, 6.5%–16.6% improvement over the runner-up, and integration with GFMs.

C2.justification: Mechanism explanations and result interpretations are unchanged. Appendix G retains the same limitations concerning overlapping classes, zero-shot learning, and previously unseen domains.

D1.justification: Implementation details, hyperparameters, hardware/software specifications, and code-access information remain identical in Section 5 and Appendices C–D. The added funding acknowledgment supplies no new reproducibility information.

R1.justification: Section 2, Appendix F, and all 54 references are unchanged. No cited work or substantive positioning relative to prior research is added or removed.

P1.justification: v2 adds the Academic Excellence Foundation of BUAA for PhD Students to the page 10 acknowledgments and updates the first-page arXiv version/date stamp. All other wording and section organization are unchanged.

P2.justification: All figures, tables, captions, and placements are identical. The acknowledgment addition only rewraps text within the existing paragraph; the page structure remains unchanged.

improvement.justification: v2 adds a funding acknowledgment and updates the arXiv stamp, while the scientific content, evidence, proofs, limitations, and reproducibility information remain identical, including the appendices. These administrative edits do not meaningfully change the paper's overall quality.
